notes:
Config: /etc/samba/smb.conf
Ports: 139/tcp (NetBIOS), 445/tcp (SMB/CIFS), 137-138/tcp (older)
Dangerous share settings: browseable=yes, read only=no, writable=yes, guest ok=yes, enable privileges=yes, create mask=0777, directory mask=0777, logon script=..., magic script=... (magic script = RCE)

recommended.note: Enumerate shares via smbclient, smbmap, CrackMapExec
Query RPC endpoints and enumerate users/RIDs
Run enum4linux-ng for full automated SMB enumeration

name: Reference - SMB Config, Ports & Dangerous Settings
description: Samba config location, SMB ports, and the share settings that lead to file read/write or code execution.
